propositions: 836 truncated bridge-echo comments across three Jira issues (REB-1567, REB-1931, REB-2605) lack the reconciler marker because truncation removes the marker appended after the body.
Comments are identified for deletion by the conjunction of: containing the reconciler's truncation suffix AND lacking the reconciler marker; the length check (32767 chars) was incorrect and removed.
Phase 2 cleanup must preserve the oldest copy per distinct normalized body and must not delete any comment referenced in the binding store's comment_ids map.
After bridge re-enabling, the keep-one rule must invert to preserve the newest (id-recorded) copy, not the oldest, to avoid orphaning the comment_ids map and recreating the original defect.
Phase 2 execution deleted 827 comments (138 from REB-2605, 276 from REB-1931, 414 from REB-1567) with zero data loss and exact distinct-body preservation verified post-deletion.

The first re-enabled bridge pass will re-post approximately one copy per distinct truncated comment (~8 across the three issues) due to empty comment_ids at cleanup time; this is expected and not a regression.
